name: @clossys/director

solves.statement: We can't explain what we are.

capabilities.subQuestion: Which strategy cells are active, and which evidence and confirmations support them?
capabilities.worldClass: One versioned cell tree records strategy choices, source citations and user confirmations; active pointers identify the current decisions.

capabilities.subQuestion: Can each installed brief contract receive active, fresh strategy cells?
capabilities.worldClass: Consumer-owned contracts compile to ready, missing or stale briefs with pinned cell versions and stable fingerprints.

capabilities.subQuestion: Does each cell meet its content, grounding, testability and confirmation rules?
capabilities.worldClass: Q1–Q7 report hard findings and judge questions before a proposed cell can activate.

capabilities.subQuestion: Do the current strategy cells agree and cite the decisions they depend on?
capabilities.worldClass: C1–C4 report missing links, stale citations, contradictions and storyline gaps without changing active cells.

capabilities.subQuestion: Which strategy levels and briefs are unlocked by the current active cells?
capabilities.worldClass: Completion reports L3, L2, L1, L0, MVS and Complete from scoped evidence without claiming an unearned level.

capabilities.subQuestion: Which downstream artifacts cite a cell version that is missing, stale or changed?
capabilities.worldClass: A central citation index traces briefs, surface markers and structured cell references, reporting stale, dangling and fingerprint drift.

capabilities.subQuestion: Does each material claim trace to dated, sourced findings?
capabilities.worldClass: Findings record observed evidence with values and aliases so grounding can report untraced claims.

capabilities.subQuestion: Does any scanned surface use a phrase the active Proof or Voice forbids?
capabilities.worldClass: The active Proof Never-claim and Voice Never bullets govern quoted phrases checked on downstream surfaces.

capabilities.subQuestion: Which observed tripwires and stale cascades require the user to revisit a decision?
capabilities.worldClass: Review opens deduplicated requests from Watch tripwires, due reviews and stale cascades without activating or editing a strategy cell.

description: The director role: is it true, and is it us? Dependency-free validators for a consumer's own strategy records (facts, mission, positioning, markets, audiences, roadmap, brand essence/attributes/derivations), a typed reader over a consumer's strategy directory, and three gates reachable from one bin — a facts-traceability gate that fails when a numeric or superlative claim cannot be traced to a facts.json entry, a brand-coverage checker over brandable token slots, and a direction-currency check that reports a derivation still citing superseded direction. Ships the schema and the checkers; every consumer authors its own values.
author: Clossys
